# One customer and three invoices, each in a state `unapply-payment` has to
# refuse for a different reason: never posted, posted but never paid, and
# posted and paid.
#
# The paid one is there so a refusal can be told from a book with nothing in
# it — a command that says "no payments to unapply" about every invoice in the
# book is not answering, and the third invoice is the control that says the
# other two answers are about those two invoices.
#
# `Liabilities:Owed Back` is somewhere for a peeled payment to land: money
# received that is no longer applied to an invoice is something you may owe
# back, and `--to` has no defensible default.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unapply_says_why_it_cannot.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Owed Back
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-UNAPPLY"
	name: "Unapply Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-DRAFT"
	customer_id: "C-UNAPPLY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Never posted"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false

invoice "INV-UNPAID"
	customer_id: "C-UNAPPLY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Posted, never paid"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-UNPAID"
		accumulate: true

invoice "INV-PAID"
	customer_id: "C-UNAPPLY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Posted and paid"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-PAID"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid in full"
